title: Editor crashes when entering simple if statement
body:
### Tested versions

Master since ba3f4a4b24fe93a77dfd1390f1b0ea4352c664ab

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (b5bdb8806) - Fedora Linux 41 (Workstation Edition) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Single-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (RADV NAVI22) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700K (24 threads)

### Issue description

Since commit ba3f4a4b24fe93a77dfd1390f1b0ea4352c664ab, I am seeing an editor crash if you enter the following text into a script:
```
extends Node3D

var count = 0
func _process(delta):
    if count>0:
```

When pressing enter after the colon, the editor crashes.

Following backtrace is generate:

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create project.
2. Attach script to node.
3. Add an if statement as listed above.
